reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides read-only tools for browsing Hacker News front-page stories, searching content, and retrieving items with bounded comments through the Algolia HN search API.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供只读的 Hacker News 首页浏览、内容搜索和条目评论查询工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with read-only tools to browse Hacker News stories, search content, and retrieve items with bounded comments.

capabilities: Search Hacker News content through the Algolia HN search API
Retrieve Hacker News items and bounded top-level comments
Register read-only tools for DeepSeek Harness agents
